text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Balanced sinusoidal wye or delta load. All values are RMS; θ is the phase-load voltage/current angle. Total S is the sum of three phase complex powers.
V_LL must be line-to-line voltage; inserting line-to-neutral voltage into √3 V_LL I_L undercounts power.
